mechanics.claim: Cosmic Radiance has no effect on untargetable allies, but will still affect the primary unit even if they become untargetable.
mechanics.quote: ''Cosmic Radiance'' has no effect on {{tip|untargetable}} allies.

mechanics.claim: Taric and nearby allies become invulnerable only after the delay elapses, not immediately on cast.
mechanics.quote: calls down a star from above that descends to him over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become {{tip|invulnerable}}
